critique: The burst now has a convincing instantaneous muzzle-flash lifetime: it is bright at 0.01 and fully absent by 0.08. Its silhouette is more directional, with a pointed forward wedge and warmer edge particles around a pale hot region. However, it still resolves primarily as a densely packed cluster of round, soft particle discs, including a distracting hollow gap near the center. It remains less sharply fragmented and less violently starburst-like than the Explosive preset thumbnail; separated fine sparks and a more distinct white ignition point are still needed.

suggestions.why: Reduce the extreme burst density so the flash does not merge into a blob and individual energetic fragments can separate visibly.
Make the visible particles substantially smaller, producing crisper spark-like detail instead of large overlapping circular discs.
Broaden the directional cone so the reduced particle count forms a wider explosive/starburst silhouette rather than a compact tube.
